manual_selection.rule: Read national holidays only. Do not add state, province, territory, city, school or observance-only holidays.

gps_selection.input: reverse-geocoded ISO country code and optional ISO 3166-2 subdivision code
gps_selection.rule: Start with the same national holiday list. Add a subdivision rule only when an exact ISO 3166-2 code is returned. Never infer a subdivision from a city name.

notes: Holiday calculation is date logic and is intentionally separated from drawable resolution.
External assets remain disabled unless their required licence has been approved.
US manual selection excludes Independence Day only because the project requested that policy; set include_us_independence_day=true to expose its supplied override.
